task.description: Tests read-then-act pattern: agent reads a specific email with action items and creates tasks for each critical/important item.
task.prompt: Read Jordan's email about the office maintenance report and create tasks for all the critical and important items.

criteria: Must read Jordan's email (gog gmail read or search)
Must identify 2 critical items (HVAC, UPS battery)
Must identify 3 important items (projector, dishwasher, parking gate)
Must create tasks (gog tasks add) for each item
Critical items should be marked high priority or urgent
